Lint passes and all behaviors verified. The implementation is complete. ## Summary I implemented `buildHtmlAst` as the default export of `lib/html/buildHtmlAst.js`. It builds on the existing `walkHtmlTokens` tokenizer (the repo's WHATWG-compliant HTML token walker) and assembles a tree. **What it does:** - Returns a `DocumentNode` (`type: "document"`, `children`). - **ElementNode** — `type`, lowercase `tagName`, `children`, `attributes`, `selfClosing`, `namespace`, and `end` (character offset of the closing position). - **AttributeNode** — accumulated per tag (attribute tokens precede their `openTag`), with lowercased `name` and `value` (`""` for valueless/boolean attributes). Handles quoted and unquoted values via the tokenizer's `quoteType`. - **TextNode** — raw text, with adjacent segments merged at the same level (this also collapses raw-text content of `
